table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	A.AccCode, 
	A.AliasName, 
	Customer=A.Name, 
	C.Address1, 
	C.Phone, 
	Category=CC.Name,
	 Area=Ar.Name,
	 SubArea=S.Name,
	LastTransDate=T.D,
	Balance=ISNULL((SELECT Bal=SUM(DEBIT - CREDIT) FROM VirtualGl V WHERE V.Date <= :ad_Date AND V.AccCode = A.AccCode), 0)
FROM 
	Customer C, Accounts A
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CODE, D=MAX(D) FROM
		(SELECT Code=CustCode, D=MAX(DATE) 
		FROM SALELEDGER 
		WHERE DATE <= :ad_Date 
		GROUP BY CustCode 
		UNION
		SELECT Code=CustCode, D=MAX(DATE) 
		FROM SRLEDGER  
		WHERE DATE <= :ad_Date 
		GROUP BY CustCode 
		UNION 
		SELECT Code=D.AccCode, D=MAX(L.DATE) 
		FROM GLHEADER L, GLDetail D 
		WHERE L.DATE <= :ad_Date AND L.GlVochCode = D.GlVochCode GROUP BY D.AccCode ) Ac
	GROUP BY Code) AS T ON (A.AccCode = T.Code), CustomerCategory CC, SubArea S, Area Ar
WHERE
	C.SubAreaCode IN (:ai_SubAreaCode) AND 
	C.CustCatCode = CC.CustCatCode AND
	C.AreaCode = Ar.AreaCode AND
	C.SubAreaCode = S.SubAreaCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode
ORDER BY
	Ar.Name,
	S.Name,
	A.Name,
	A.AliasName
